chapter.verse: Topa phat un! Topa tungah lungdamna ko un, bang hang hiam cih leh amah hoih a, ama itna kip kho tawntung hi!
Topa ’ nasepna lianpite kua in genkhia thei-in, amah phatna khempeuh lakkhia thei ding ahi hiam?
Thutang a zui, a tawntunga thuman-a gamta mite in mi nuamsa ahi hi!

Topa aw, nangma teel mite’ daupaina ka muh theih nading, nangma minamte’ kipakna sungah ka lungdam theih nading, nangma luahte tawh ka minthan’ khawm theih nadingin, na mihingte tungah maipha na lah ciangin kei hong phawk in la, amaute na hotkhiat ciangin kei hong huh in.
Ka pate uh leh kote ka khial khin uh hi; mawhna ka bawl khin uh a, ka gitloh gamtat khin uh hi.
Ka pate un Izipt gamah a om lai-un nangma nasepna lamdangte ngaihsun lo uh hi; nangma itna kip a tampite phawk lo uh a, San Tuipi-ah Sang Penpa hong lehdo uh hi.
Ahi zongin amah in, a lian mahmah ama vangliatna a kitheihsak nadingin, ama min a ngaihsutna-in amaute honkhia hi.
Amah in San Tuipi thuhilh a, tua tuipi kang hi; amah in gamlak kantan bangin tuithuk kantanin amaute paipih hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in, galte khut sung panin amaute hon a, a langpangte’ vangliatna panin amaute khahkhia hi.
Tui in amau’ langte tummang a, amaute a suakta khat zong om lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in ama thu um uh a, amah phatna sa uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in ama nasepte mangngilh pah uh a, ama thugen ding ngak loin gamta pah uh hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in gamlak ah deihluat mahmah na nei uh a, sehnel gam sungah Pasian ze-et uh hi;
amah in amaute’ nget pen pia a, ahih hangin amaute sungah siatna tung sak hi.
Giahphual-ah, mite in Moses leh Topa ’ mi siangtho Aaron a hazat uh ciangin,
lei kihongin Dathan valhtum a, Abiram’ pawlte vukcip hi.
Amaute sungah mei hong piangkhia a, meikuang in migilote kangtum hi.
Amaute in Horeb gam sungah bawngno khat bawl uh a, a kisung tua milim bia uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian’ minthan’na pen, lopa a ne bawngtal lim tawh kheekna uh hi.
Amaute in Izipt gam sungah na lianpite a bawl, Ham’ gam sungah nalamdangte leh San Tuipi-ah a kihtak-huai nate a bawl, amau’ Honpa, Pasian mangngilh uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute a suksiat nading a hehna panin a heikhia dingin ama mai-ah a teelpa Moses ding hi kei leh—amaute ka susia ding hi, amah in ci hi.
Amaute in gamnuam simmawh uh a, ama thuciamna um lo uh hi.
Amaute a puanbuk sung uh-ah phun uh a, Topa ’ thu ngai lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in a khut laamto-in, gam sungah amaute puk sak a, leitung gam khempeuh minamte lakah amau’ suan-le-khakte a thehthang ding kiciam hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Peor mun-a Baal pasian beel uh a, nuntakna a nei lote tunga biakna kipiate a ne uh hi;
amau’ gamtatna tawh Topa ’ heh nading piangsak uh a, amaute lakah pulnatna hong tung hi.
Tua ciangin Finehas ding-in hong palai-a, pulnatna hong dai hi.
Tua thu pen, a khang a khangin ama thumanna-in kiciamteh tawntung hi.
Amaute in Meribah tuiphual-ah amah sinso sak uh a, Pasian’ Kha langpang uh hi; thakhat-a kamkhauh a pau kha Moses in amaute’ hu hauin siatna ngah lawh hi.
Topa in amaute a thupiak bangin, amaute in tua mite that lo uh hi.
Minam dangte tawh kihelin amau gamtat bangbang a gamta dingin kisin uh hi.
Amau adingin thangzak ahi, amau milimte’ na seppih uh hi.
Amaute in, a tapate uh leh a tanute uh dawi biakna-in nei uh hi;
amaute in, Kanaan gam milimte a biakna-un, mawhna nei lo a tanute uh leh a tapate uh that uh a, hih mi thahna hangin gamsung a nin a suak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amau sepna tawh amaute a nin suak uh a, amau gamtatnate tawh palhngulhna a bawl uh hi.
Tua ciangin ama mite tungah Topa ’ hehna hong kikuantawh a, amah in ama luah minamte a kih hi;
amau a mudah minamte in a uk theih nadingin tua minamte’ khut sungah amaute a pia hi.
A galte un amaute nengniam uh a, amau’ khut nuai-ah koih uh hi.
Amah in amaute tam veipi honkhia hi; ahih hangin amaute in lehdona lungsim vom uh a, amau mawhna hangin amaute kiniam koih hi.
Tua bang ahi ta zongin, amah in amaute’ kikona a zak ciangin, amaute’ cihmawhna a don hi.
Amaute ading a ngaihsutna-in ama thuciamna a phawk a, ama itna kip lianpi tawh kizui-in a kolsak hi.
Amaute a man mi khempeuhte in a khasiatpih zah dong dingin amah in amau tungah a piangsak hi.
Topa, kote’ Pasian aw, kote hong hon in la, nangma min siangtho kong phat theih nading uh leh nangma tungah lungdamna kong koh theih nadingun, minamte lak panin kote hong kaikhawm kik in.
Topa, Israel Pasian in, a tawntung a kipan a tawntung dongin thupha ngah ta hen! Mi khempeuh in, “Amen” ci ta uh hen! Topa phat un!
